subject: science

concepts.title: Stages of Animal Nutrition
concepts.definition: The biological process of obtaining and utilizing nutrients, consisting of ingestion, digestion, absorption, assimilation, and egestion.
concepts.formula: nutrition_process = ingestion + digestion + absorption + assimilation + egestion
concepts.key_idea: Nutrition is a multi-step sequence from food intake to waste removal.
question_patterns: what are the main steps of nutrition
list the sequence of animal nutrition
define the process of nutrition in animals
how does an animal utilize food
justify why stages of animal nutrition matters

solution_steps.explain: Nutrition proceeds as ingestion, digestion, absorption, assimilation, and egestion
Each stage follows the previous one in a fixed sequence from food intake to waste removal
Confirm that ingestion begins the process and egestion ends it, with absorption and assimilation occurring in between

concepts.title: Role of Villi in Absorption
concepts.definition: Millions of microscopic finger-shaped folds lining the small intestine from inside; they widen the absorbing surface so nutrients pass into the blood more easily.
concepts.key_idea: Increased surface area leads to higher nutrient absorption rates.
question_patterns: what is the function of villi
where are villi located
how do villi help in digestion
why is the small intestine wall folded
solve a numerical on role of villi in absorption

solution_steps.explain: villi increase the base surface area by a factor
absorption is proportional to the effective surface area
Compare total_absorption with the base_area absorption to confirm villi increase nutrient uptake

concepts.title: Rumination Process
concepts.definition: A unique digestive mechanism in grass-eating animals where food is stored in the rumen, partially digested, and later returned to the mouth for thorough chewing.
concepts.key_idea: Ruminants digest tough cellulose by cycling food between the rumen and the mouth.
question_patterns: what is rumination
why do cows chew continuously
define ruminants
how do grass-eating animals digest cellulose
state two key points about rumination process

solution_steps.explain: Grass-eating animals first swallow food quickly into the rumen for partial digestion
Partially digested food (cud) is returned to the mouth for thorough chewing
Confirm the food cycles between rumen storage and mouth re-chewing to break down tough cellulose

concepts.title: Amoeba Feeding Mechanism
concepts.definition: Amoeba captures microscopic prey by extending pseudopodia to engulf food into a vacuole where digestive juices break it down.
concepts.key_idea: Amoeba uses temporary false feet to trap food and internal vacuoles to digest it.
question_patterns: how does amoeba ingest food
what are pseudopodia
where does digestion occur in amoeba
describe the feeding process of amoeba
why is amoeba feeding mechanism important

solution_steps.explain: Amoeba extends temporary false feet (pseudopodia) around the food particle
Pseudopodia fuse to trap the food inside a food vacuole
Digestive juices act on the food inside the vacuole, breaking it down for absorption
